The '''OT-3 Industrial Repair Droid''' was a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] model produced by the [[Okara Droid Company]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Galactic War]]. OT-3 Industrial Repair Droids were deployed within the [[Okara Droid Factory]].
